Search the text messages
Also looks in your text messages for the words you type. They are read on the phone, only while you search. Needs the permission to read messages.
Most recent first
The tile you open goes to the front of its group, so the ones you use stay first. Tiles you placed on a cell of your own do not move.
Choose a look
Pick the look to start from. Every choice can be changed later in the settings.
Windows Phone 8.1
Flat tiles, the retro bar and the original launch animation: as close to the phone it comes from as it gets.
Glass
Frosted, rounded glass over a glowing backdrop.

Keep as it is
What’s new in %1$s

• You choose the order of the navigation buttons: in Settings, Navigation bar, drag back, Start and search where you want them.
• One Metro banner for each notification, the same words are not announced twice.
• What’s new now always shows the changes of the version you have.
• The Settings in the Metro look no longer crash: the Wi-Fi password, the manual time and the cellular page work, and Shizuku is explained.

What’s new in this version
The changes of this version, in your language.
What is wrong?
Nothing is wrong: the permissions and services the launcher uses are on.
The tiles and the Action Center cannot show notifications. Touch to allow notification access.
The lock gesture, the bars over other apps and the two-finger swipe do not work. Touch to turn the service on (only if you use them).
Banners and bars over other apps cannot be drawn. Touch to allow it (only if you use them).
The commands that need system rights stay off. Start Shizuku, then allow the launcher (only if you use them).
The launcher cannot post its own notifications (timers, alarms, recordings). Touch to allow them.
The network type and the names of the SIMs are not shown. Touch to open the permissions of the launcher.
Contact tiles, People and the search of contacts stay empty. Touch to open the permissions.
Event tiles, the agenda and the search of events stay empty. Touch to open the permissions.
Android may stop the launcher in the background, so live tiles and alarms come late. Touch to remove the limit.
